name: Rinkan ~Kizumono no Imouto~
source:
Sister gets vice chairman of president council position after becoming president's lover. But jealously burns in main character. Sister will be insulted and humiliated.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
妹妹成为学生会长的恋人后，获得学生会副会长职位。但主人公心中燃起嫉妒，妹妹将遭到侮辱和羞辱。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
